failure_modes.recovery: Pick assigned_to from the team members list; status/stamps are door-owned.
failure_modes.when: assigned_to is not a member of your tenant, title is missing, or a workflow field was sent

description: [REQUIRES APPROVAL] Delegates a task to a teammate (or yourself) as a new team_assignment; status is workflow-owned and always starts 'pending' — passing status yourself fails validation instead of being silently overridden. Accepts natural language for the common fields: task_name/task for title, due_date/due for due_at ('YYYY-MM-DD', epoch millis, 'today', 'tomorrow', or 'next <weekday>'), and 'self'/'me'/'yourself' for assigned_to. assigned_to must already be a member of your tenant. NEXT: team_assignment_accept, then _start and _complete, drive the lifecycle from there.

due.description: Alias of due_at (same accepted forms as due_date).

due_date.description: Alias of due_at — "YYYY-MM-DD", "today", "tomorrow", or "next <weekday>" (epoch milliseconds also works — pass it via due_at directly instead).

task_name.description: Alias of title — the task's name in plain language.

name: team_assignment_create
